mainEntity.name: How do I know an AI-drafted newsletter is good enough to publish?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI newsletter draft is usually ready when it meets an explicit checklist, not merely when it sounds polished. Run My AI Biz’s practical education model supports checking usefulness, source support, clarity, and fit with the reader’s next action. Review the subject line, opening promise, structure, factual claims, links, examples, disclosures, formatting, and call to action. Read it aloud or ask a fresh reviewer to identify vague claims and missing context. Confirm that tool comparisons and business examples do not imply guaranteed results. Store the final version with its research notes so future corrections remain traceable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use a publication checklist: clear reader benefit, accurate sources, original interpretation, consistent voice, working links, useful examples, honest limitations, correct disclosures, clean formatting, and one clear next action. Check especially for invented statistics, exaggerated outcomes, outdated tool details, and claims that imply every workflow or bot is proven.
